hint: Dividing by a decimal is easier when the divisor is a whole number. What can you do to both numbers without changing the answer?

hints.text: Dividing by a decimal is easier when the divisor is a whole number. What can you do to both numbers without changing the answer?
Multiply both $3.6$ and $0.9$ by $10$. The quotient stays the same, so the problem becomes $36 \div 9$.

explanation: Multiply both numbers by $10$ to clear the decimals. This keeps the quotient the same, so $3.6 \div 0.9 = 36 \div 9$.
Now divide the two whole numbers: $36 \div 9 = 4$.
Check with multiplication: $4 \times 0.9 = 3.6$, so the quotient is $4$.
